text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...? I could have sworn someone just 
called my name..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...C-Could it be... were that the Three 
Goddesses...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Said to be the origin of racing 
history, the foundational Umamusume—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Into the great river that all of you have 
created... I will surely follow...!
